functions.about: What each lens draws over a position, from the side you play: Pawns (weak and passed pawns, holes, the structure's name), Pieces (activity green/amber/red, each side's worst piece, outposts, knight routes to your two nearest), Space (who holds each square and by how much, the count in each other's half), Kings (zone, attackers, missing shield pawns, open lines, a grade), Threats (hanging and cheaply attacked men, what the last move newly threatens).
Squares each side holds outright in the other's half.
A king's danger: attacks on its zone, missing shield pawns and open lines count up, defenders count down; in check or 7 and up is Under attack, 3 and up Exposed, else Safe.
The pawn breaks a side has in a position (a pawn capture, or a push that attacks a pawn), with that side to move; none when the other side is in check.
